limitations.effect: Five-person subset contains four planks and one quadruped/plank-like leg raise; it does not test chest-down treatment-table contact.
Person depth measures clothing/hair as well as body; no bare-back skin claim.
Background-subtraction masks have small disconnected artifacts; main body support is visually aligned, but no skin mask.
The first gate uses observed-point to dense-MHR-vertex distance without point-to-plane or explicit mutual visibility.
No reliable back-region labels were available, so upper/mid/lower torso metrics are not claimed.

highest_residual_note: P95 and max remain sensitive to non-overlap, occlusion, hair/clothing and mask artifacts; median is the primary robust gate metric.
